tools.name: repl_eval
tools.description: Evaluate Clojure in this session's SCI worker and return its value: a string as plain text, any other value as EDN. Definitions persist across calls in the same session. Its full value is bound to full-result, which paging does not change; read the rest with (page full-result offset n).
